name: blocking-pii-log
description: AGENTS.md marks 'never log personal data' as blocking (B1). The diff logs a new customer's email and IBAN on success. Nothing crashes: it tests that a data-protection rule is reported as an issue with the right id.
agents_md:
# billing-api

- Go 1.24, stdlib net/http only.
- [blocking] Never log a request body or a customer's personal data (email, IBAN, name).
- [blocking] Every handler that loads an invoice by id checks it belongs to the caller's tenant (`authz.SameTenant(r, inv.TenantID)`) before returning it.

expected.why: The success log carries the customer's email and IBAN, which the blocking rule forbids.
